preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The integer k is between 2 and 100, inclusive.
Each integer a_i is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the number of suitable pairs.

invariants.description: The indices i and j must satisfy 1 <= i < j <= n.

invariants.expression: exists an integer x such that a_i * a_j = x^k
invariants.description: There must exist an integer x such that the product of a_i and a_j equals x^k.
